_note: A NOTAM's own card, the engine's notam_card (engine/crates/weather/src/notam_read/card.rs), read from its parts as FAA Order JO 7930.2 gives them: the keyword (1-2-1), a surface and its condition (3-3-5, 3-3-6; CLSD and NA, JO 7340.2), an FDC procedure NOTAM's titles (7-1-3), PERM (4-2-1). The first is the owner's FDC 6/3373 at KARR (2026-11-23); each answer is worked by hand from the NOTAM's words. engine/facade/tests/notam_read.rs asks the engine each case.
